_doc: The political geometry of the KloggKimball western-US sheet: New California Republic states, Caesar's Legion split north and south by its civil war, and the Brotherhood of Steel's discrete chapters. Boundaries are the author's; their POSITION carries the sheet's own registration, which is about a kilometre. Names were read by eye at recorded anchor pixels; a feature with name null is ground the sheet fills and does not letter, and is kept rather than dissolved because the author drew its border.

provenance.permits: boundaries, at the sheet's own registration
provenance.warning: Do not carry the 27.9 km author-placement residual onto these polygons. It measures where the author put his MARKERS against real geography and is the right figure for the site layer; a border traced off the sheet inherits the sheet's fit.
